description: The United States Air Force at Ellsworth AFB is conducting Market Research, in accordance with FAR Part 10, to identify possible sources for the leasing and associated maintenance of IR Heat Maintenance Services for buildings on Ellsworth AFB. Details, instructions, and advisories for the Sources Sought are included in Attachment 1 entitled - Sources Sought - IR Heat Maintenance. Specifications and details for the requirement are included in Attachment 2 entitled - Draft PWS ? IR Heat Maintenance.
